content.short: Rialto is a spot exchange on Robinhood Chain for trading tokenized stocks, ETFs and crypto.
content.description: Rialto is a proprietary-AMM spot venue built on Robinhood Chain, trading tokenized equities and ETFs alongside crypto assets. Robinhood's own chain documentation names it among the day-one applications on the network. Tokenized equities are the reason Robinhood Chain exists as a dedicated chain rather than a deployment on an existing L2, and Rialto is one of the venues where those assets actually change hands.
